name: pamdemod
comment: Sig x=pamdemod(y,M[,ini_phase,symorder]): inverse of pammod. DEFAULT 'bin': pamdemod([-3 -1 1 3],4)=[0 1 2 3]. 'gray' inverse: pamdemod([-3 -1 3 1],4,0,'gray')=[0 1 2 3] (so xg(3)=2, xg(4)=3). M=8 bin maps the full amplitude ladder back to [0..7]. Matches the corrected pammod default ('bin').
